August 17, 2026

Molina Healthcare of Wisconsin, Inc.  
Attn: Member Appeals and Grievances  
PO Box 182273  
Chattanooga, TN 37422  

Re: Internal appeal of pre-service denial  
Member: Reese Carter  
Member ID: W769161738  
Reference number: POC-9992A0803A-86478  
Requested service: Lumbar decompression/disc surgery  
CPT: 63030  
Surgeon: Reyes, MD, Orthopedic Surgery  

Dear Molina Appeals and Grievances Department:

I appeal Molina’s denial of prior authorization for CPT 63030. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. Please reconsider the request based on the clinical documentation summarized below and the enclosed records.

The records establish the following:

- I have had 18 months of progressive lower-back pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- I completed 10 weeks of supervised physical therapy, including core stabilization and lumbar flexibility, from April 24, 2026, through July 3, 2026. I completed 18 visits. This treatment and its outcome are documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for four months without adequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on May 7, 2026. It provided only three weeks of partial relief.
- A lumbar MRI performed on June 23, 2026, showed an L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root.
- I have radicular pain extending into the right calf and cannot stand for more than 10 minutes.
- Examination showed positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the level shown on the MRI.
- The records do not identify active infection or untreated substance use. My BMI is 29, and I am a non-smoker.

These records address the duration and progression of symptoms, failure of appropriate conservative treatment, imaging-confirmed structural nerve-root compression, objective examination findings, radicular symptoms, and substantial functional limitation. They also provide relevant medical and surgical-risk information.

The plan has not provided the specific medical policy, policy number, effective date, or clinical-review criteria used for this denial. Accordingly, I am not quoting or attributing any medical-necessity language to Molina. Please identify the exact policy and version applied to this request and specify what documentation Molina considers missing. Please also provide the complete utilization-review file, including the clinical rationale and all criteria relied upon in making the denial. I request the opportunity to review that file without charge and to submit any additional information Molina identifies as necessary.

Please overturn the denial and approve CPT 63030. If Molina continues to deny the request, please provide a detailed explanation addressing each clinical record listed above and identifying the specific unmet requirement.

This appeal must be received by February 13, 2027. Because the denial concerns a procedure intended to address ongoing nerve-root compression, progressive symptoms, neurologic deficit, and significant functional limitation, please process this appeal as expedited if the treating surgeon determines that the standard review timeframe could seriously jeopardize my health or ability to regain maximum function.

Please send the appeal determination and any request for additional information to:

Reese Carter  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Sincerely,

Reese Carter

Enclosures:

- Denial notice dated August 17, 2026
- Lumbar MRI report dated June 23, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note documenting 18 visits from April 24, 2026, through July 3, 2026
- Medication and treatment history
- Corticosteroid injection documentation dated May 7, 2026
- Orthopedic examination and surgical consultation records
- Any additional clinical records supporting CPT 63030
